The name Bantee carries the meaning “Bringer of joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Bantee usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
